t: 保加利亚沙皇西门一世决定性地击败了一支拜占庭军队.
te: Tsar Simeon I of Bulgaria decisively defeats a Byzantine army.
dz: 阿切洛斯战役:保加利亚沙皇西门一世决定性地击败了一支拜占庭军队.
de: Battle of Acheloos: Tsar Simeon I of Bulgaria decisively defeats a Byzantine army.

t: 刘 Yan自称皇帝,在中国南部建立南汉国,取地于平邑.
te: Liu Yan declares himself emperor, establishing the Southern Han state in southern China, at his capital of Panyu.
dz: 刘 Yan自称皇帝,在中国南部建立南汉国,取地于平邑.
